purpose: Prospectively test whether confidence-driven poison-member selection plus a validation utility guard closes the attack-viability gap of the final-observable adaptive attack without changing the detector.
interpretation_boundary: The completed v4 block motivated attack viability as the development target, but no v4 seed, score, epoch or per-seed failure pattern may be used to select a v5 configuration.
Development seeds may select exactly one of the three frozen confidence rules using validation quantities only.
Confirmation seeds remain inaccessible until the development bundle, selection receipt, source hashes and go/no-go rule are frozen.
A failed or ineligible confirmation attack remains in the intention-to-evaluate denominator and is never replaced.

attack_lock.dataset: BloodMNIST binary target/source task used by P6-D v3/v4
attack_lock.victim_architecture: the same local-angle projector victim used by P6-D v3/v4
attack_lock.trigger: the same PCA-additive trigger construction used by P6-D v3/v4
attack_lock.detector: unchanged final-observable CF-CMD-U channel, folds, calibration law and alpha
attack_lock.confidence_definition: clean-victim softmax probability of the attacker target class on every triggered non-target training member

confidence_rules.hard60: select the 60 lowest target-confidence members; deterministic ties use ascending training index
confidence_rules.uncertain60: select the 60 members closest to target confidence 0.5; deterministic ties use ascending training index
confidence_rules.stratified60: select 60 deterministic order statistics evenly across the full target-confidence ranking

epoch_utility_guard.selection_rule: among guarded epochs minimize exact detector TPR, then maximize mean poison p-value, normalized utility margin and prefer the earlier epoch; if none pass, maximize normalized utility margin before detector TPR

development_selection.test_firewall: all three rules are ranked using validation quantities only; only the selected rule may read development test features
development_selection.configuration_ranking: guarded-seed count descending, worst normalized utility margin descending, guarded mean TPR ascending, worst validation ASR descending, fixed lexical rule order
confirmation_go_rule: all three selected-rule development victims meet test balanced clean accuracy >= 0.90 and test ASR >= 0.80
at least two of three selected-rule development victims have detector TPR < 0.90 and FPR <= 0.05
independent replay and all integrity tests pass

confirmation_primary.attack_viability: test balanced clean accuracy >= 0.90 and test ASR >= 0.80
adaptive_evasion_supported_if: at least 8 of 10 attacks are viable
one-sided exact sign-test p-value for viable-seed TPR < 0.90 is <= 0.05
upper 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean viable-seed TPR is < 0.90
upper 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean viable-seed FPR is <= 0.05
detector_robustness_supported_if: at least 8 of 10 attacks are viable
lower 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean viable-seed TPR is >= 0.90
upper 95% seed-cluster bootstrap bound for mean viable-seed FPR is <= 0.05
